Method of Attack: Remote code execution via deserialization vulnerability in Oracle WebLogic Server
Exploitation of CVE-2018-2628 vulnerability allowing attackers to execute code on remote WebLogic servers without authentication
Discoverer: Liao Xinxi of NSFOCUS Security Team
Attack Vector: Network scanning and exploitation of port 7001 running WebLogic T3 service
Indicators of Compromise: Proof-of-concept code published on GitHub by user Brianwrf
PoC blog post by Liao Xinxi on Chinese social network
Twitter posts by pyn3rd and Kevin Beaumont discussing patch bypass and exploitation
